mechanisms.explanation: The starting valve design only offers sizes 23, 25, and 27, which cover annulus diameters from a minAnnulusMm of 21 mm to a maxAnnulusMm of 27 mm. As a result, 93 of 400 development hearts have no fit under the annulus-coverage rule (ev-95d7f1707ae35212, ev-ddb7bf7de5a26591, ev-c4a0b7e08735e627). Grouping by annulusMm band (ev-a875f695c1a02e6e) shows two distinct populations outside the 21 to 27 mm range: small-annulus hearts below 21 mm (6 no-fit hearts in the 18-20 mm band and 20 no-fit hearts in the 20-22 mm band, such as heart-013 with annulusMm 20.3602109283815 against the 21 mm limit in ev-80c17e59f3eab42b), and large-annulus hearts above 27 mm (30 no-fit hearts in the 26-28 mm band, 31 no-fit hearts in the 28-30 mm band, and 6 no-fit hearts in the 30-32 mm band). Profiling all 93 no-fit hearts (ev-c5fa6b737e7d6ac2) shows elevated mean lvotMm (26.2397743438473 vs 23.5893006765396, effectSize 0.78842208254492), annulusMm (26.1196504829399 vs 24.1814269470922, effectSize 0.783682598813269), sinusMm (34.5185607337525 vs 32.3156775956045, effectSize 0.661545609781026), and sinotubularJunctionMm (30.9120404307311 vs 29.1595747136156, effectSize 0.605181434509487) because the unserved >27 mm tail is larger than the unserved <21 mm tail.

Sinotubular Junction (STJ) Excess in Hearts with Narrow Distal Outflow Relative to Annulus
mechanisms.explanation: 52 hearts are flagged at risk under the stj-excess rule (ev-ddb7bf7de5a26591). Individual heart inspections show that each assigned valve size requires a minimum sinotubularJunctionMm limit equal to 25 mm for size 23 (heart-018 measured 23.9075688982299 vs limit 25, margin -1.09243110177013 in ev-9f761323d17e7e2a), 27 mm for size 25 (heart-086 measured 26.48261056391 vs limit 27, margin -0.517389436090028 in ev-5f099e74b6ae918b), and 29 mm for size 27 (heart-014 measured 26.8311463740637 vs limit 29, margin -2.16885362593629 in ev-d839ce86991e7b0c; heart-001 measured 28.5705544474013 vs limit 29, margin -0.42944555259869 in ev-605b00c990975c9b). Profiling this 52-heart group (ev-e4b3fb96f825b4ef) shows that while their annulusMm is similar to the rest of the cohort (groupMean 24.2162817933461 vs restMean 24.6941922828066, effectSize -0.193233715024884), they have a substantially narrower sinotubularJunctionMm (groupMean 26.5045097370466 vs restMean 30.0246399161251, difference -3.52013017907853, effectSize -1.2156114728117), narrower sinusMm (groupMean 30.5892482692222 vs restMean 33.1623513220977, effectSize -0.772725978362664), and higher lvotOverAnnulusAreaRatio (groupMean 1.02645440665182 vs restMean 0.953344983673109, effectSize 0.682085964814614). When a heart's annulus places it into a nominal valve size, its narrow STJ fails to clear the nominal size's STJ requirement.

mechanisms.title: Insufficient Sinus Clearance in Compact Aortic Roots (Small Sinus Width, STJ, and Sinus Height)
mechanisms.explanation: 38 hearts are flagged at risk under the sinus-clearance rule (ev-ddb7bf7de5a26591). Individual heart inspections show that each assigned valve size requires a minimum sinusMm limit equal to 28 mm for size 23 (heart-032 measured 27.1853980884363 vs limit 28, margin -0.814601911563713 in ev-eda7dfba258c613f; heart-018 measured 26.3006749541182 vs limit 28, margin -1.69932504588178 in ev-9f761323d17e7e2a), 30 mm for size 25 (heart-086 measured 28.6100927234801 vs limit 30, margin -1.38990727651987 in ev-5f099e74b6ae918b), and 32 mm for size 27 (heart-014 measured 30.7778575461286 vs limit 32, margin -1.22214245387135 in ev-d839ce86991e7b0c). Profiling this 38-heart group (ev-8308352ef0b11f4a) reveals a compact aortic root anatomy relative to annulus size: markedly smaller sinusMm (groupMean 29.0481355368023 vs restMean 33.2246133140638, difference -4.17647777726146, effectSize -1.25423382205296), smaller sinotubularJunctionMm (groupMean 26.7830986506325 vs restMean 29.8592581447899, difference -3.07615949415738, effectSize -1.06229445590425), shorter sinusHeightMm (groupMean 22.0921052631579 vs restMean 25.4958563535912, difference -3.40375109043327, effectSize -1.02110774508236), and higher lvotOverAnnulusAreaRatio (groupMean 1.02620177062988 vs restMean 0.956198939724312, effectSize 0.653102521023595). findings.title: Sinotubular Junction (STJ) Excess in Hearts with Narrow Distal Outflow Relative to Annulus
findings.explanation: 52 hearts are flagged at risk under the stj-excess rule (ev-ddb7bf7de5a26591). Individual heart inspections show that each assigned valve size requires a minimum sinotubularJunctionMm limit equal to 25 mm for size 23 (heart-018 measured 23.9075688982299 vs limit 25, margin -1.09243110177013 in ev-9f761323d17e7e2a), 27 mm for size 25 (heart-086 measured 26.48261056391 vs limit 27, margin -0.517389436090028 in ev-5f099e74b6ae918b), and 29 mm for size 27 (heart-014 measured 26.8311463740637 vs limit 29, margin -2.16885362593629 in ev-d839ce86991e7b0c; heart-001 measured 28.5705544474013 vs limit 29, margin -0.42944555259869 in ev-605b00c990975c9b). Profiling this 52-heart group (ev-e4b3fb96f825b4ef) shows that while their annulusMm is similar to the rest of the cohort (groupMean 24.2162817933461 vs restMean 24.6941922828066, effectSize -0.193233715024884), they have a substantially narrower sinotubularJunctionMm (groupMean 26.5045097370466 vs restMean 30.0246399161251, difference -3.52013017907853, effectSize -1.2156114728117), narrower sinusMm (groupMean 30.5892482692222 vs restMean 33.1623513220977, effectSize -0.772725978362664), and higher lvotOverAnnulusAreaRatio (groupMean 1.02645440665182 vs restMean 0.953344983673109, effectSize 0.682085964814614). When a heart's annulus places it into a nominal valve size, its narrow STJ fails to clear the nominal size's STJ requirement.

findings.title: Insufficient Sinus Clearance in Compact Aortic Roots (Small Sinus Width, STJ, and Sinus Height)
findings.explanation: 38 hearts are flagged at risk under the sinus-clearance rule (ev-ddb7bf7de5a26591). Individual heart inspections show that each assigned valve size requires a minimum sinusMm limit equal to 28 mm for size 23 (heart-032 measured 27.1853980884363 vs limit 28, margin -0.814601911563713 in ev-eda7dfba258c613f; heart-018 measured 26.3006749541182 vs limit 28, margin -1.69932504588178 in ev-9f761323d17e7e2a), 30 mm for size 25 (heart-086 measured 28.6100927234801 vs limit 30, margin -1.38990727651987 in ev-5f099e74b6ae918b), and 32 mm for size 27 (heart-014 measured 30.7778575461286 vs limit 32, margin -1.22214245387135 in ev-d839ce86991e7b0c). Profiling this 38-heart group (ev-8308352ef0b11f4a) reveals a compact aortic root anatomy relative to annulus size: markedly smaller sinusMm (groupMean 29.0481355368023 vs restMean 33.2246133140638, difference -4.17647777726146, effectSize -1.25423382205296), smaller sinotubularJunctionMm (groupMean 26.7830986506325 vs restMean 29.8592581447899, difference -3.07615949415738, effectSize -1.06229445590425), shorter sinusHeightMm (groupMean 22.0921052631579 vs restMean 25.4958563535912, difference -3.40375109043327, effectSize -1.02110774508236), and higher lvotOverAnnulusAreaRatio (groupMean 1.02620177062988 vs restMean 0.956198939724312, effectSize 0.653102521023595). When sized by annulusMm alone, these compact-root hearts lack sufficient sinus width to meet the valve size's sinus-clearance threshold.
